title: command_pause
description: Schema for pause command-JSON files written to $STATE_DIR/commands/ by the operator (via the \btw scribe slash-command or directly). Polled between iterations by orchestrator.sh main loop via lib/command_dispatch.sh (FUP-0815). Pause is honored at the next iter-boundary AFTER the current iteration completes — it NEVER interrupts an in-flight Consumer-confirm cycle (FUP-0797 BINDING). additionalProperties:true mirrors the FUP-0734 / FUP-0749 precedent on gate_request.schema.json — do NOT re-tighten without re-verifying against current scribe emission shape.

command_type.description: Discriminator. MUST be the literal string 'pause'.

command_id.description: Stable identifier for this command instance. Convention: pause_<iso8601_utc> (e.g., pause_2026-06-02T22-15-00Z). Used as the basename for the response.json sibling (e.g., pause_2026-06-02T22-15-00Z.response.json) and for the archived copy under commands/.processed/.

issued_by.description: Identifier of the caller. Convention: 'operator-cc-scribe' for scribe-originated; 'operator-direct' for direct CLI authoring; free-form otherwise.

issued_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of command issuance (e.g., 2026-06-02T22:15:00Z).

reason.description: Optional free-form rationale for the pause (informational; not consumed by dispatch logic).
